title: Data of a normalized derived adjoint lift of a ringed-topos morphism
statement: Let $X,Y$ be small ringed-site presentations with commutative coefficient sheaves, their unbounded module derived categories, and fixed closed tensor structures, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a ringed-topos morphism, all as in [def-sfb-ringed-derived-comparison-data]. An adjoint lift of $f$ is the following data. It has a scalar-extension edge $e$ from the tensor corner of $Y$ to that of $X$, including the ordinary module adjunction and universal left-derived pullback with comparison $\epsilon$, a derived right adjoint and their adjunction. The inverse and direct image functors of $e$ equal those of $f$, its geometric adjunction agrees with that of $f$ after these identifications, its module pushforward equals that of $f$, and its structural ring map agrees with the given map of $f$ after the inverse-image identification. Its ordinary module Hom bijection, after forgetting coefficients and identifying pushforwards, is the geometric Hom bijection applied to scalar insertion followed by the underlying pullback morphism. The module pushforward is additive. A natural transformation $\eta:Q_Y f_*\to e_R Q_X$ makes $e_R$ the universal right-derived functor of module pushforward and is invertible on K-injective complexes. For every flat-term K-flat complex $P$ over $Y$, the comparison $\alpha_P:e_L Q_Y P\to Q_X f^*P$ induced by $\epsilon$ is invertible. For every such $P$, every K-injective complex $I$ over $X$, and every chain map $b:P\to f_*I$, the inverse derived-adjunction transpose of $Q_Y(b)$ followed by $\eta_I$ equals $\alpha_P$ followed by $Q_X$ of the inverse ordinary-adjunction transpose of $b$. This is a record of witnesses and normalization equations, with no existence or tensor-coherence assertion.
